tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new KanbanThing board and return its id, shareable URL and password. No sign-up. Every board is password protected: pass `password` to choose one, otherwise a random password is generated and returned. Give both the URL and the password to whoever should use the board. tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read a board by id: its name, expiry, columns and how many cards each column holds.

tools.name: list_columns
tools.description: List the columns on a board, left to right, with their ids.

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List the cards on a board, optionally only those in one column.

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Add a card to a column on a board. Lands in Backlog when no column is given.

tools.name: move_card
tools.description: Move a card to another column on the same board, at the end of that column.

tools.name: update_card
tools.description: Change a card title, description, due date or colour. Pass null to clear a field. Use move_card to change column.

tools.name: delete_card
tools.description: Permanently delete a card from a board. This cannot be undone.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_board" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
